gloss: way of eating; eating manner; how to eat

definitions.gloss: way of eating; how to eat; eating manner
definitions.explanation: The manner in which someone eats — whether referring to instructions for a particular food, table manners, or an individual's eating habits. Formed by attaching the suffix {方|かた} ('way of doing') to {食|た}べる.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{方|かた}が{汚|きたな}い。
examples.english: Their way of eating is messy.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}の{食|た}べ{方|かた}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me how to eat this dish.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもには{箸|はし}の{正|ただ}しい{食|た}べ{方|かた}を{早|はや}いうちから{教|おし}えたい。
examples.english: I want to teach my child the proper way to eat with chopsticks from an early age.

notes:
Formed by the productive pattern verb-stem + {方|かた} ('way of Xing'). Applies to both manner (table manners) and method (instructions for an unfamiliar food).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{方|かた}が{上手|じょうず}・{下手|へた}: skilled / clumsy at eating
- {食|た}べ{方|かた}が{綺麗|きれい}・{汚|きたな}い: neat / messy eating manner
- {正|ただ}しい{食|た}べ{方|かた}: the proper way to eat
- {食|た}べ{方|かた}を{教|おし}える: to show how to eat

RELATED PATTERN:
- {作|つく}り{方|かた}: how to make
- {読|よ}み{方|かた}: how to read; reading (of a kanji)
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}: how to use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食事|しょくじ}の{作法|さほう}: dining etiquette — specifically formal manners
- {食|く}い{方|かた}: rougher/casual variant — masculine, colloquial, can sound coarse
